description: Anything you do yourself is allowed. Approval is about what FRIDAY does on her own, not about what you do at the keyboard.
An agent may read from memory when its current step needs to. Reading changes nothing and never leaves the machine.
Writing something into memory needs your approval, because FRIDAY will act on it later as if it were true.
Forgetting something needs your approval, and cannot be undone.
A scheduled job may check FRIDAY's own health and verify the audit log. Nothing outside FRIDAY is touched.
